elevenlabsPrompt:
[exasperated] Your iPhone's at 20 percent by lunch and you barely touched it?

[confident] Here's the fix. Check the battery list in Settings.

[friendly] Open Settings, then Battery. Scroll to the apps. The top one is your drain. Turn off its Background App Refresh.

[delighted] Now it stops eating battery while it sits in your pocket.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
